title: Agent Chat: cannot set MovieClip instance name (no name param surfaced / no rename tool)
description:
REPORT (user): The Agent Chat agent cannot set the INSTANCE NAME on a MovieClip instance it adds to the stage ("not sure if it's a missing tool param or what"). Instance names are essential: AS2 and the agent reference instances as _root.<instanceName>; without naming, the agent cannot wire interactivity.

PLACEMENT COMMAND: stage_place_instance.
- Schema: packages/agent-protocol/src/index.ts:220-227 (StagePlaceInstanceParamsSchema) — DOES have a name param at index.ts:224 (name: z.string().optional()), but it is UNDESCRIBED (no .describe()).
- Tool description: packages/agent-protocol/src/index.ts:1111-1112 — vague: 'with optional name/transform' — never states this is the AS2 instance name used as _root.<name>.
- Handler: packages/authoring-ui/src/agent/registry.ts:867-947 — DOES wire it: instanceName: params.name (registry.ts:931) onto the SymbolInstance. So naming AT CREATION already works at runtime.

POST-PLACEMENT RENAME: There is NO dedicated instance rename/set-name tool (only library_rename, scene_rename, and layer rename via timeline_update_layer exist). stage_update (index.ts:264-273 schema; registry.ts:1044-1073 handler) takes a generic updates: z.record(...) and applies { ...o, ...updates } (timeline.ts:1091-1093), so at RUNTIME passing updates:{ instanceName:'x' } would set it — BUT the typed contract DisplayObjectUpdates (packages/core/src/model/timeline.ts:7-40) OMITS instanceName, so renaming an existing instance is unsupported-by-contract and undiscoverable. The system prompt (packages/authoring-ui/src/agentchat/systemPrompt.ts, 52 lines) gives ZERO guidance about instance naming or _root.<name>.

MODEL + COMPILE SUPPORT (confirmed working):
- Model: SymbolInstance.instanceName exists — packages/core/src/engine/types.ts:535 ('AS2 instance name (for getURL, attachMovie, onClipEvent, etc.)').
- Compile: PlaceObject2 name IS emitted from instanceName via encodePlaceObject2WithName — packages/swf/src/compiler/frames.ts (instance path ~948-1058), matching CLAUDE.md's 'Named text fields need the name in PlaceObject2' rule, so _root.<name> resolves at runtime once the name is set.

ROOT CAUSE: mixed (b)+(c), primarily (c) discoverability/contract gap (NOT fully blocked / not (a)):
- The name param exists and is wired (rules out pure (a)), AND model+compile support it.
- BUT: (1) the create-time name param is undescribed and the tool description is vague, so the agent is not steered to use it nor told it maps to _root.<name>; (2) there is no instance rename/set-name tool; (3) stage_update's typed DisplayObjectUpdates omits instanceName (timeline.ts:7-40), so renaming an existing instance is unsupported by contract; (4) the system prompt offers no naming guidance.

EXPECTED: The agent can reliably name an instance — a clearly described name/instanceName param on stage_place_instance AND/OR an instance set-name path (either a dedicated set_instance_name tool or instanceName added to DisplayObjectUpdates so stage_update can rename), wired to SymbolInstance.instanceName and emitted as the PlaceObject2 name so _root.<name> resolves at runtime.

ACTUAL: Create-time naming works but is undiscoverable (undescribed param + vague description + no prompt guidance); there is no supported way to set/rename the name AFTER placement (DisplayObjectUpdates omits instanceName, no rename tool).

FIX DIRECTION:
1. Add .describe() to StagePlaceInstanceParamsSchema.name and sharpen the stage_place_instance description (index.ts:224, 1112) to state it is the AS2 instance name used as _root.<name>.
2. Add instanceName to DisplayObjectUpdates (packages/core/src/model/timeline.ts:7-40) and to the stage_update typed params + description (index.ts:264-273, registry.ts:1044-1054) so the agent can rename an instance after placement; and/or add a dedicated set_instance_name tool.
3. Add a short note to systemPrompt.ts about naming instances (and that named MC/text instances are addressable as _root.<name> in AS2).
4. Add a registry/tools test asserting both create-time naming and post-placement rename set SymbolInstance.instanceName.

Priority: medium — blocks the agent from scripting named instances (core authoring/interactivity wiring).
